title.en: Equipotential Surfaces for a Point Charge
title.hi: बिंदु आवेश के लिए समविभव पृष्ठ

description.en: For an isolated point charge, the equipotential surfaces are concentric spheres centered at the charge. The electric field lines are radial, cutting the equipotential surfaces at right angles.
description.hi: एक विलगित बिंदु आवेश के लिए, समविभव पृष्ठ आवेश पर केंद्रित संकेंद्रित गोले होते हैं। विद्युत क्षेत्र रेखाएं अरीय होती हैं, जो समविभव पृष्ठों को समकोण पर काटती हैं।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <g transform="translate(200, 200)">
    <!-- Equipotential Surfaces -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="60" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 4" />
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="110" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 4" />
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="160" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 4" />
    
    <!-- Electric Field Lines -->
    <g stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)">
      <line x1="25" y1="0" x2="180" y2="0" />
      <line x1="-25" y1="0" x2="-180" y2="0" />
      <line x1="0" y1="25" x2="0" y2="180" />
      <line x1="0" y1="-25" x2="0" y2="-180" />
      <line x1="17.6" y1="17.6" x2="127.2" y2="127.2" />
      <line x1="-17.6" y1="-17.6" x2="-127.2" y2="-127.2" />
      <line x1="17.6" y1="-17.6" x2="127.2" y2="-127.2" />
      <line x1="-17.6" y1="17.6" x2="-127.2" y2="127.2" />
    </g>
    
    <!-- Charge -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="15" fill="#ef4444" />
    <text x="0" y="6" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">+</text>
  </g>
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrowhead" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#3b82f6" />
    </marker>
  </defs>
</svg>

description.en: A parallel plate capacitor with area A and separation d. The uniform electric field E points from the positive plate to the negative plate.
description.hi: A क्षेत्रफल और d दूरी वाला एक समांतर प्लेट संधारित्र। एकसमान विद्युत क्षेत्र E धनात्मक प्लेट से ऋणात्मक प्लेट की ओर इंगित करता है।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <g transform="translate(150, 50)">
    <!-- Dielectric/Space -->
    <rect x="20" y="0" width="160" height="200" fill="#f0fdf4" />
    
    <!-- Plates -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="20" height="200" fill="#ef4444" rx="3" />
    <rect x="180" y="0" width="20" height="200" fill="#3b82f6" rx="3" />
    
    <!-- Charges -->
    <text x="10" y="25" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">+</text>
    <text x="10" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">+</text>
    <text x="10" y="105" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">+</text>
    <text x="10" y="145" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">+</text>
    <text x="10" y="185" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">+</text>

    <text x="190" y="25" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">-</text>
    <text x="190" y="65" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">-</text>
    <text x="190" y="105" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">-</text>
    <text x="190" y="145" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">-</text>
    <text x="190" y="185" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">-</text>

    <!-- Electric Field Lines -->
    <g stroke="#374151" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrowhead-gray)" stroke-dasharray="4 2">
      <line x1="25" y1="30" x2="175" y2="30" />
      <line x1="25" y1="65" x2="175" y2="65" />
      <line x1="25" y1="100" x2="175" y2="100" />
      <line x1="25" y1="135" x2="175" y2="135" />
      <line x1="25" y1="170" x2="175" y2="170" />
    </g>

    <!-- Distance Dimension -->
    <g stroke="#64748b" stroke-width="1.5">
      <line x1="20" y1="220" x2="180" y2="220" />
      <line x1="20" y1="215" x2="20" y2="225" />
      <line x1="180" y1="215" x2="180" y2="225" />
    </g>
    <text x="100" y="240" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">d</text>
    
    <!-- Labels -->
    <text x="10" y="-15" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444" text-anchor="middle">+Q</text>
    <text x="190" y="-15" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#3b82f6" text-anchor="middle">-Q</text>
    <text x="100" y="-15" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#10b981" text-anchor="middle">Area = A</text>
  </g>
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrowhead-gray" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#374151" />
    </marker>
  </defs>
</svg>
